Gap: "map to unprotected DSCP values (array)". Producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmDSCPFlag. TestXFRMStateCarriesTheOuterDSCP asserts copy builds the outbound tunnel state without DontEncapDSCP and a mapping to 0 builds it with the flag (Linux then writes outer DSCP 0), so the state holds the bypass choice exactly. TestXFRMStateRefusesOuterDSCPItCannotWrite asserts a mapping on a transport-mode SA, outside the field's tunnel-mode applicability, is refused with ErrSAOptionRefused (its 46 and inbound cases serve other rows). The scoped assertions hold. The per-value array is honestly disclosed as unbuilt, and a fixed value other than 0 is refused on Linux XFRM by xfrmDSCPFlag (LL-XFRM-OUTER-DF-SET-DSCP), homed in plan/post-release/kernel/spec-xfrm-outer-df-set-dscp.md, which lists this row.
